headline: Oil rises more than 1% after attacks on oil tankers and stalled talks to end the war - Libya 24 News
summary: Oil prices rose more than 1% amid rising Middle East tensions, attacks on oil tankers and stalled ceasefire talks. Concerns centre on navigation and energy supplies through the strait.
why: Brent crude is the main global benchmark for oil, so disruptions to tanker traffic in key shipping lanes quickly feed into energy prices.
why_moved: Attacks on oil tankers and stalled ceasefire talks raised concerns about navigation and energy supplies through the strait.
